from ledgerly import audit
from ledgerly.adjustments import write_off
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError
from ledgerly.models import Invoice, LineItem

T = datetime(2026, 2, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
inv = Invoice("inv_1", "cus_1", lines=[LineItem("Seat", 1, Decimal("50.00"))], status="issued")
r = write_off(inv, T, "insolvent", idempotency_key="k1")
print(r, inv.status)
assert set(r) == {"invoice_id", "amount", "reason"}
assert r["amount"] == Decimal("50.00") and inv.status == "void"
# idempotent replay
r2 = write_off(inv, T, "insolvent", idempotency_key="k1")
assert r2 == r
# non-issued rejected
try:
    write_off(inv, T, "again")
except BillingError as e:
    print("rejected:", e.code)
else:
    raise AssertionError("should reject")
print("OK")
